verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a domain registrar, but the evidence documents no first-party export of account data in open formats and no outbound transfer or offboarding flow. The transfer pages cover only moving domains into Dynadot. The general-purpose API is a developer building block, not an export capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
